resources.string: Elixium is playing in the background
No app on this phone can pick a file.
Elixium could not start. Reopen the app to try again.

Elixium can save music to the Music folder on your phone, where other apps can find it. Android grants this on its own settings screen. Without it, downloads still work, but they stay inside the app where nothing else can see them.
This phone has no screen for that permission.
